name: manual_a5ff33
claim: Bunny Stream Token Authentication broke video loading on static sites — prefer simple client-side gating.js over server-side signing for non-DRM content

decisions.notes: Token Auth added complexity without meaningful protection; gating.js with CSS class .lesson-video proved reliable on 148-page site

rationale: Token Auth added complexity without meaningful protection; gating.js with CSS class .lesson-video proved reliable on 148-page site
